title: The Perfect Cocktail
cn: 第 22 集 · 完美鸡尾酒
novel: Marshall and Barney were [[feuding|feud]] because Marshall had quit GNB and Barney felt [[abandoned|abandon]]. Their friendship was on the line. Robin and Lily decided to [[intervene|intervene]] by finding the perfect cocktail that would force the two men to make up. They believed that different drinks had different effects on people's [[personalities|personality]]. They started [[experimenting|experiment]] with various combinations of alcohol. Beer made Marshall [[sentimental|sentimental]] and Barney [[lazy|lazy]]. Wine made them both [[philosophical|philosophical]] but also sleepy. Whiskey made Barney [[aggressive|aggressive]] and Marshall [[teary|teary]]. Tequila made them both [[reckless|reckless]] and [[unpredictable|unpredictable]]. After many failed attempts, Robin and Lily discovered that a specific [[blend|blend]] of cocktails could bring out the best in both men. The perfect cocktail made Marshall brave enough to [[apologize|apologize]] and Barney honest enough to admit he missed his friend. Meanwhile, Ted planned a romantic weekend with Zoey. He had [[reserved|reserve]] a cabin in the woods and prepared a [[picnic|picnic]] basket filled with their favorite foods. However, the trip was [[jeopardized|jeopardize]] when Ted realized that Zoey was still [[secretly|secret]] fighting to save the Arcadian building. He felt that she was not being completely [[honest|honest]] with him about her intentions. Ted confronted Zoey about her secret campaign, and they had a [[heated|heated]] argument in the car. Zoey told Ted that she was fighting for what she believed in, and Ted told Zoey that their relationship could not survive if they were on opposite sides of every issue. They [[agreed|agree]] to try one last weekend together before making any final decisions. Back at the bar, Marshall and Barney drank the perfect cocktail and [[reconciled|reconcile]]. They hugged and promised to never let work come between them again. The gang raised their glasses and toasted to [[friendship|friendship]], the only thing stronger than any cocktail.

feud.en: to have a long and bitter argument

abandon.en: to leave someone when they need you

intervene.en: to get involved in a situation to help

personality.en: the character and qualities of a person

experiment.en: to try something to see what happens

lazy.en: not willing to work or use energy

philosophical.en: thinking deeply about life and meaning

aggressive.en: behaving in an angry or forceful way

teary.en: having tears in the eyes from emotion

reckless.en: doing things without thinking of danger

unpredictable.en: changing in a way you cannot expect

blend.en: a mixture of different things together

apologize.en: to say sorry for something you did wrong

reserve.en: to arrange for something to be kept for you

picnic.en: a meal eaten outdoors, usually in a park

jeopardize.en: to put something in danger of being lost

secret.en: in a way that others do not know about

honest.en: telling the truth and not lying

agree.en: to have the same opinion as someone

reconcile.en: to become friends again after a fight
